title: File:Glomus Jugulare Tumor.jpg
author: Michael Hawke MD
description: The triangular red coloured mass behind the tympanic membrane in the middle ear is a highly vascular tumor known as a glomus tumor. Because of the intense vascularity of these tumors, they can be seen pulsating. Because this tumor arises from the dome of the jugular bulb [which constitutes a large portion of the floor of the middle ear, it is referred to as a glomus jugulare.
